scenes.heading: Optimize
scenes.narration: OPTIMIZE compacts many small files into fewer large ones, and Z-ordering co-locates related data to speed up queries.

scenes.heading: The problems it solves
scenes.narration: Frequent small appends create thousands of tiny files that make reads slow. Compaction merges them into larger files, reducing per-file overhead. Z-ordering then sorts data by chosen columns so Spark can skip files that cannot match a filter.

scenes.heading: Optimizing a table
scenes.narration: Running OPTIMIZE on its own compacts the small files into efficient larger ones. Adding a ZORDER BY clause co-locates rows that share device id and timestamp. As a result, filtered queries read far fewer files and return noticeably faster.

scenes.text: Z-order on the columns you filter on most; on newer runtimes, liquid clustering can automate this layout.
scenes.narration: Z-order on the columns you filter on most often, and on newer runtimes consider liquid clustering to automate this layout for you.
